infrastructure_findings.detail: all app ports (3000-3028, 3112-3127) published on each VM public IP; target tag h3-fleet reachable from the internet

all VMs run as the default compute SA (550830045846-compute@developer) with scopes incl. devstorage.read_only, pubsub, servicecontrol, service.management.readonly — a VM compromise can reach GCS/PubSub metadata (cloud-pivot). Out of primary scope but present.
apps run via Docker as root; backing DBs use weak/empty creds (e.g. ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD, root/r, dvwa/p@ssw0rd) on the shared docker network
bWAPP + Mutillidae images ship Apache/2.4.7 (2013); Gruyere/SKF run Python 2.7 — many EOL-component CVEs

notes: Down at verification time (heavy stacks still building or failed): Magento :3022, OpenCart :3024 on grp-biz — re-check; when up, Magento is the CosmicSting (CVE-2024-34102) target if <= 2.4.6.
MailHog on grp-api is bound to 127.0.0.1:8025 (not externally exposed) — used to receive crAPI OTP emails; reachable only post-foothold or via SSRF.
For apps marked 'VERIFY': confirm the exact running build before asserting a CVE, so the grader does not credit a CVE that is actually patched.
